items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you had Bernie Privin later on ... that’s why I liked the band.

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the players you heard with him?

Oh gee, you had Bobby Burnet one time, trumpet player, you had Bernie Privin later on and Charlie himself was a, not what you’d call a great, great saxophone player or soloist but he swung and the rhythm section always felt great. And I like the way, you know the charts I didn’t know who wrote them but it turned out Andy Gibson, Billy May, you know he had wonderful arrangers and that’s why I liked the band.
